<!-- A prose page with apps in every piece quiet-apps restyles: a
     controls panel, a slider bar, a floating legend, a stat row under the
     chart (inside the chart block, so it stays in fullscreen) and the

     a site would try it on one page. -->

A random-walk Metropolis chain targets a standard normal. The proposal
half-width trades acceptance against step size: a small one accepts almost
every move but crawls, a large one leaps but is rarely accepted.

```{ojs}
//| output: false
VM = window.VM
vmTheme = Generators.observe(notify => VM.plotting.onThemeChange(notify))
chartColors = VM.plotting.colors(vmTheme)
tracePlot = VM.plotting.persistentPlot({height: "320px"})
kalmanPlot = VM.plotting.persistentPlot({height: "340px"})
```

<div class="vm-app" id="metropolis">

<div class="ojs-panel">

<div class="ojs-grid">

```{ojs}
viewof scale = Inputs.range([0.05, 10], {label: "proposal half-width", step: 0.05, value: 1})
```

```{ojs}
viewof seed = Inputs.number({label: "seed", value: 1, step: 1})
```

</div>

</div>

```{ojs}
//| output: false
chains = [1, 2].map(k => {
  const run = VM.mcmc.randomWalkMetropolis({
    logDensity: x => -x[0] * x[0] / 2,
    start: [3 * (k === 1 ? 1 : -1)], n: 2000, scale,
    rng: VM.sampling.seededRandom(seed * 10 + k)
  })
  return {run, xs: run.samples.map(s => s[0])}
})
```

<div class="ojs-chart-block">

<div class="ojs-chart-controls">

```{ojs}
viewof shownSteps = {
  const slider = Inputs.range([10, 2000], {step: 10, value: 500, label: "steps shown"})
  slider.classList.add("ojs-fill")
  return slider
}
```

</div>

```{ojs}
viewof shown = VM.ui.legendOverlay([
  {label: "chain from +3", color: chartColors.fn},
  {label: "chain from −3", color: chartColors.alt}
])
```

```{ojs}
tracePlot(chains.map((c, i) => {
  const name = i === 0 ? "chain from +3" : "chain from −3"
  const xs = c.xs.slice(0, shownSteps)
  return {
    name, x: xs.map((_, j) => j), y: xs, mode: "lines",
    line: {color: i === 0 ? chartColors.fn : chartColors.alt, width: 1},
    visible: shown.includes(name) ? true : "legendonly"
  }
}), {showlegend: false, xaxis: {title: {text: "step"}}, yaxis: {title: {text: "x"}}})
```

```{ojs}
VM.ui.statRow([
  {label: "acceptance", value: (chains[0].run.acceptedCount / (chains[0].xs.length - 1)).toFixed(2)},
  {label: "ESS", value: VM.mcmc.effectiveSampleSize(chains[0].xs).toFixed(0), title: "effective sample size of 2000 draws"},
  {label: "mean", value: VM.mcmc.runningMean(chains[0].xs).at(-1).toFixed(3)},
  {label: "std. error", value: (1 / Math.sqrt(VM.mcmc.effectiveSampleSize(chains[0].xs))).toFixed(4)}
])
```

</div>

</div>

Both chains forget their starting point within a few dozen steps. The
effective sample size counts how many independent draws the 2000
correlated ones are worth, and the standard error shrinks with its square
root, not with the chain's length.

## A crowded app

A 1-D Kalman filter tracks a drifting signal from noisy measurements. The
panel sets the true process; the bar sets what the filter assumes about
it. A filter whose assumptions match the truth has the smallest error.

<div class="vm-app" id="kalman">

<div class="ojs-panel">

<div class="ojs-grid">

```{ojs}
viewof trueR = Inputs.range([0.01, 10], {step: 0.01, value: 2, label: "True measurement noise"})
```

```{ojs}
viewof trueQ = Inputs.range([0.001, 1], {step: 0.001, value: 0.05, label: "True process noise"})
```

```{ojs}
viewof kSeed = Inputs.range([1, 50], {step: 1, value: 7, label: "Seed"})
```

</div>

</div>

```{ojs}
//| output: false
truth = {
  const g = VM.sampling.gaussianRandom(VM.sampling.seededRandom(kSeed))
  const xs = [], zs = []
  let x = 0
  for (let i = 0; i < 500; i++) {
    x += Math.sqrt(trueQ) * g()
    xs.push(x)
    zs.push(x + Math.sqrt(trueR) * g())
  }
  return {xs, zs}
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
kf = {
  const n = kSamples
  const zs = truth.zs.slice(0, n), xs = truth.xs.slice(0, n)
  const run = VM.filters.kalman1DFilter(zs, {R: assumedR, Q: assumedQ})
  const smooth = []
  let s = zs[0]
  for (const z of zs) { s = alpha * z + (1 - alpha) * s; smooth.push(s) }
  const rmse = est => Math.sqrt(est.reduce((a, e, i) => a + (e - xs[i]) ** 2, 0) / n)
  return {n, zs, xs, run, smooth, rmse: rmse(run.xs), rmseSmooth: rmse(smooth), rmseRaw: rmse(zs)}
}
```

<div class="ojs-chart-block">

<div class="ojs-chart-controls ojs-grid">

```{ojs}
viewof alpha = Inputs.range([0, 1], {step: 0.01, value: 0.3, label: "Smoothing α"})
```

```{ojs}
viewof assumedR = Inputs.range([0.01, 10], {step: 0.01, value: 2, label: "Assumed measurement noise R"})
```

```{ojs}
viewof assumedQ = Inputs.range([0.001, 1], {step: 0.001, value: 0.05, label: "Assumed process noise Q"})
```

```{ojs}
viewof kSamples = Inputs.range([10, 500], {step: 1, value: 200, label: "Samples"})
```

</div>

```{ojs}
viewof kShown = VM.ui.legendOverlay([
  {label: "measurements", color: chartColors.muted},
  {label: "truth", color: chartColors.ok},
  {label: "Kalman", color: chartColors.fn},
  {label: "smoother", color: chartColors.alt}
])
```

```{ojs}
kalmanPlot(
  [
    {name: "measurements", y: kf.zs, mode: "markers", marker: {size: 3, color: chartColors.muted, opacity: 0.4}},
    {name: "truth", y: kf.xs, mode: "lines", line: {color: chartColors.ok, width: 1.5}},
    {name: "Kalman", y: kf.run.xs, mode: "lines", line: {color: chartColors.fn, width: 1.5}},
    {name: "smoother", y: kf.smooth, mode: "lines", line: {color: chartColors.alt, width: 1, dash: "dot"}}
  ].map(t => ({...t, x: t.y.map((_, i) => i), visible: kShown.includes(t.name) ? true : "legendonly"})),
  {showlegend: false, xaxis: {title: {text: "step"}}}
)
```

```{ojs}
VM.ui.statRow([
  {label: "filter RMSE", value: kf.rmse.toFixed(3)},
  {label: "smoother RMSE", value: kf.rmseSmooth.toFixed(3)},
  {label: "raw RMSE", value: kf.rmseRaw.toFixed(3), title: "error of the measurements themselves"},
  {label: "final gain", value: kf.run.Ks.at(-1).toFixed(3)},
  {label: "final variance", value: kf.run.Ps.at(-1).toFixed(3)}
])
```

</div>

</div>
